metadata.title: Agentic attack detections for Microsoft Sentinel: pentagi
metadata.description: 2 analytics rules, 5 hunting queries and the AGENTIC_IOCs watchlist. Built by tools/build_sentinel.py from https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
Name of the Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel on. It must be in the resource group you deploy to.
Start the analytics rules enabled. Off by default: review and baseline them first.

properties.displayName: PentAGI agent command wrapper on a host
properties.description:
A process ran PentAGI's agent command wrapper (trap "" HUP, raise /proc/self/oom_score_adj by one, exec sh -c "$0"),
or referenced a pentagi-terminal-<flow> worker container or a vxcontrol image. PentAGI runs every agent command this way
(backend/pkg/docker/flow_commands.go), so this host is running PentAGI engagements.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence: https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (ProcessCommandLine contains "/proc/self/oom_score_adj" and ProcessCommandLine contains "exec sh -c")
    or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("pentagi-terminal-", "vxcontrol/kali-linux", "vxcontrol/pentagi")
| summarize Events=count(), Commands=make_set(substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 300), 10), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated) by DeviceName, DeviceId

properties.displayName: PentAGI update check from your network
properties.description:
A host called update.pentagi.com, which every PentAGI installation does every three hours by default
(backend/pkg/server/update/update.go). PentAGI is running on that host or behind it: confirm it is an approved test.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence: https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceNetworkEvents | where RemoteUrl has "update.pentagi.com" | project TimeGenerated, Host=DeviceName, Detail=RemoteUrl),
    (DnsEvents | where Name has "update.pentagi.com" | project TimeGenerated, Host=ClientIP, Detail=Name),
    (CommonSecurityLog | where DestinationHostName has "update.pentagi.com" or RequestURL contains "update.pentagi.com" | project TimeGenerated, Host=SourceIP, Detail=RequestURL)
| summarize Calls=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Host
